title: Zero-Share Redemption on Clients With Empty Balances
rootCause: _withdrawInternal() checks amount > 0 on the input parameter but then caps amount to clientBalances[token][balanceHolder]. If balanceHolder has zero balance, amount becomes 0, proceeds to vault.convertToShares(0) = 0, then vault.redeem(0, ...) which reverts on many ERC4626 implementations.
impact: Unexpected revert for edge case of withdrawing from a zero-balance client. No fund loss but poor error messaging.
recommendation: Add early return after capping: if (amount == 0) return;
